coordinate_contract.signal_time_convention: evaluate detector-grouped Beammap telescope-plus-pointing coordinate at recorded t + tau
coordinate_contract.negative_tau: the signal is best registered with an earlier delivered telescope state
coordinate_contract.map_comparison: the existing Beammap timing equivalent is (right centroid minus left centroid)/(right rate minus left rate) and has the opposite sign from this direct t+tau coordinate-shift tau; compare direct tau to the negative of that map value
coordinate_contract.center_authority: per-detector x_t_raw/y_t_raw from the direction-blind standard APT
coordinate_contract.shape_authority: per-detector a_fwhm/b_fwhm/angle from the direction-blind standard APT

selection.method: network-balanced round-robin of descending standard-APT S/N
selection.quality: a1100 standard flag=0, flag2=0 when present, finite positive amplitude/width/SNR and finite nonnegative centroid errors

support.scan_definition: one repaired same-timebase inclusive row of full-PTC scan_indices/raw_scan_indices
support.edge_rule: retain samples only when t plus or minus 50 ms stays within that scan
support.baseline: constant fitted per detector-scan on fixed off-source support
support.amplitude: nonnegative and profiled independently per detector-scan

models.constant: global delta_x/delta_y relative to all standard-APT detector centers
models.lag: constant model plus one common tau in the complete t+tau coordinate
models.scan_hysteresis: constant model plus a half-separation along the data-derived principal scan axis times sign of projected velocity
models.joint: constant plus both common tau and scan-axis hysteresis

interpretation_boundary: A direct within-full-PTC comparison to the map-centroid timing equivalent. It does not identify hardware versus software cause, establish universality, or authorize a correction.
